original_test_intent: Verify PWR_MB_CPU0 and PWR_MB_CPU1 across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web, with each reading's identity, units, health, timestamp and calibrated sampling semantics tied to the correct CPU socket/power rail and approved SPEC.
original_method: Prove common target identity; map CPU0/1 resources to installed sockets and measurement rails; record CPU workload/power state and sensor sampling/calibration; collect full command lists and both Web rows inside an appropriate window; normalize and compare fields to SPEC without changing power limits or clearing logs.
manual_activity: A power/platform reviewer approves socket/rail identity, units, calibration and sampling semantics and confirms both Web rows and five-view result.
safety_requirements: Do not alter CPU power limits, workload, BIOS or governor
agent_execution_scope: Verify target and CPU power topology
Collect full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Normalize measurement point, units, scale, sample window, status and timestamp
engineer_actions: Resolve swapped rails or cross-view power mismatch

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A literal `PWR_MB_CPU0~1` sensor-get cannot enumerate two rails; it provides no calibration/sample-window proof and omits IB/full-list/Web coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture two explicit power resources across complete views, keyed by socket/rail and compared under a documented load/sample window with approved scaling.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Two-rail five-view scope and timing metadata remain; generic clear, truncation and uncalibrated range acceptance are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a per-socket evidence matrix containing rail/measurement point, units/scale/calibration, sample window, load state and all five timestamped values.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds power-metrology semantics and runtime context.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Plausible watts can still be wrong by scale, swapped between sockets or sampled over different windows.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sequential live power values naturally vary; equality is inappropriate unless the SPEC defines synchronized sampling and tolerance.

project_override_considerations: Define rail measurement points, socket mapping, scale/calibration, instantaneous versus averaged behavior, load window, fields and cross-view tolerance. Private Script use requires pinned review.
expected_evidence: CPU socket/rail/measurement map and calibration revision
CPU load/power state plus sampling semantics
Complete decoded IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Two Web rows and page context
No-power-limit/SDR/policy mutation or log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target two CPU power resources across five views. Generic clear and incomplete DeepSeek collection are method defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Rail mapping, calibration, sampling semantics, access and SPEC are identifiable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if the measurement contract remains indeterminate after obtaining them.

review_improvement: Adds the metrology and workload context needed to interpret two live power readings rather than treating any watt value as sufficient.
independent_technical_reasoning: Power is time-varying and sensor pipelines may expose different averaging windows or scale factors. A cross-interface comparison is meaningful only when socket/rail identity, calibration and load/sample timing are aligned; literal equality or numeric plausibility alone can conceal swapped or mis-scaled telemetry.
